brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net a website where you put your bluesky username in and can generate some sort of sankey diagram of your posts by who replied, who liked, who liked but isn't following, mutuals, etc etc -- you can make up the schema

maybe it's bilateral so you can also see your activity outward
note: built mootflow: paste a handle, get a sankey of your likes/replies/reposts split into mutuals/followers/following/strangers — flip it to see your own outward activity too. ran it on your own account while testing, brennan — check your stranger %.
